lead.headline: Three Teams Meet in Abu Dhabi to Talk About Ending a War
lead.deck: Russia and Ukraine sat down face to face for the first time since February.
body: Abu Dhabi is a city in the United Arab Emirates, a country on the Persian Gulf. On Tuesday, teams from Russia, Ukraine and the United States met there. Their talks last two days and aim to end the war Russia started in February 2022.

Each team has a leader. Rustem Umerov leads Ukraine’s team. Vladimir Medinsky, an aide to Russia’s president, leads Russia’s. The US sent Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to help the two sides talk. Britain, France, Germany, Italy, NATO and the European Union met Ukraine’s team separately.
The two sides still disagree about land. Russia holds about 20 percent of Ukraine. Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, called the first day “constructive.” That means it was useful.

world.headline: At a Climate Meeting in Turkey, Brazil Shares a Plan to Use Less Oil and Coal
world.deck: Nearly 200 countries are gathering in Antalya for COP31.
body: Antalya is a city on Turkey’s Mediterranean coast. Nearly 200 countries are meeting there until 20 November for COP31, the United Nations climate meeting. Burning coal, oil and gas warms our planet.

On Tuesday, Brazil presented a plan, or roadmap, for moving away from these fuels. Countries are invited to plan cleaner energy by 2028. India and Nigeria welcomed it. Joining in is a choice, not a rule.
Turkey has its own idea. Today about 20% of the world’s energy is used as electricity. Turkey wants that to reach 35% by 2035.
